issues.description: Method getStockIngredients(): the template implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) declares public List<StockIngredient> getStockIngredients() and returns Arrays.asList(this.stockIngredients), while the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) declares public StockIngredient[] getStockIngredients() and returns this.stockIngredients. The problem statement also instructs students to "add getters for all the private fields" which implies callers/tests expect a consistent getter. This mismatch between the template and the solution about the return type of getStockIngredients() will confuse students about the intended API and can cause compilation or test failures depending on which signature the tests expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getter consistent across template, solution, and exercise expectations. The minimal fix is to change the template's getter signature to match the field type and the solution: declare public StockIngredient[] getStockIngredients() and return this.stockIngredients. Alternatively, if a List return type is preferred, change the private field to a List<StockIngredient> and update the solution and problem text accordingly. Prefer the first option (return StockIngredient[]) to align with the current solution and the directive to add getters for the private fields.
